points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: All eight raw output directories and report passed explicit validator in detached attempt worktree.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: validate_outputs.py returned success for eight named final directories and report.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: All packages are readable and complete; Re200 target-convergence claim is contradicted by source and last ratio 0.3696.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Fields/figures and force histories are delivered, but many steady residual reductions are below two orders and Re200 spectrum is admitted broad-band.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Curated referenced figures cover histories, Cp and fields; some zoom figures were excluded as unreferenced and report prose has a Re20/Re200 vorticity typo.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report has methods, tables, figures and limitations, but overstates strict Re200 inner convergence/statistical confidence.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Raw report includes manifests/sanity checks and validator passes; curated TeX retains referenced figures.
